messages:
alex: Thinking about organizing a small office LAN next Friday after 6pm. Who's in? Planning 3 stations: PC (Steam), Switch dock, and a retro corner. Need monitors, ethernet, and spare controllers.
jamie: Count me in! I can bring an extra controller and a PS-style USB hub. :thumbsup:
priya: I can bring a 27" monitor + Switch dock. Happy to run the Mario Kart rotation.
dan: I have a spare Steam Deck and a 5m ethernet adapter I can bring. Can also do some Rocket League.
lucy: Snacks on me — will grab vegan and non-vegan options. Also bringing an HDMI cable and a small surge protector.
marco: I can host a Steam Remote Play slot for anyone without a PC. Will need a stable 5GHz/ethernet. Also can stream a match to the mezz projector if that's free.
alex: Awesome — @marco could you take the stream if mezz is available? Also we only have one managed switch with 8 ports in the office, so bring splitters/power strips if you need more.
jamie: +1 on the projectile streaming idea. @eng-infra any chance to reserve mezzanine projector for 7–10pm? :pray:
event-bot: Reminder: Please add your name to the sign-up sheet: <https://tinyurl.com/redwood-lan|Redwood LAN sign-up>
alex: PS: Bring any special controllers (fight sticks, GC pads). If you need to bridge Wi-Fi for the Deck, bring a laptop that can do ICS.
priya: Quick poll — do we want a retro corner with N64/SNES? Reply with Y/N.
dan: Y
marco: Y — I can bring my N64 and Smash cart.
jamie: N (noted, but I'd still play Mario Kart)
alex: Cool, looks like retro corner confirmed. I'll order pizza (2 vegetarian, 1 gluten-free). If anyone's bringing drinks, add to the sheet.
lucy: I'll bring drinks. Also bringing extra ethernet cables (1m, 3m, 5m).
alex: Perfect. I'll post a final checklist Wed morning. Thanks all! :party_popper:
